testResults.name: focused-parquet-tests
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_lake_parquet.py

decisions: The writer consumes the T021 date-first partition_path contract and schema_for registry without modifying either existing module.
Records are normalized to the selected schema, canonical symbol, UTC nanosecond timestamps, and exact Decimal values; binary floats are rejected for decimal fields.
LocalFilesystemStore exposes atomic os.replace whole-object semantics behind the ObjectStore protocol; Azure and blob transports are deferred.
Parquet payloads use Zstandard compression and preserve T021 field and schema metadata, including nested condition item names.
ParquetMetadata records the committed relative path, row count, byte count, and SHA-256 checksum of the exact payload sent to the store.
limitations: No Azure or blob data-plane operation was run because transport ownership is explicitly deferred; local filesystem behavior is covered instead.
